fix: Track the newest read that produced a valid value and let any newer valid answer win.
impact: Panel stays on 7d for the session though the setting is 30d.
mechanism: Only the newest issued read may write state.defaultRange, so read 1 is discarded and read 2 writes nothing.
sweep: Only readDefaultRange writes state.defaultRange besides the initial state.
title: A valid answer is dropped when a newer read then fails
trigger: 1. Open the panel (read 1). 2. Change Default range (read 2). 3. Read 1 answers 30d, read 2 times out.
